title: Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai
description: When his boss (John Tormey) turns against him, a hit man (Forest Whitaker) who lives like a samurai must fend for his life.

title: Mojave
description: A down-and-out artist (Garrett Hedlund) has a dangerous and shocking encounter with an evil drifter (Oscar Isaac) in the desert, leading to terrifying consequences when the deadly stranger follows his unsuspecting victim home.

title: Arctic
description: A man stranded in the Arctic after an airplane crash must decide whether to remain in the relative safety of his makeshift camp or to embark on a deadly trek through the unknown in hopes of making it out alive.

title: Head Office
description: A U.S. senator's son (Judge Reinhold) gets a job at a conglomerate and falls for the chairman's (Eddie Albert) radical daughter.

title: Chasing Mavericks
description: Hearing that the mythic Mavericks surf break is real, a teenage surfer (Jonny Weston) asks a local legend (Gerard Butler) to teach him how to ride the wave and live to tell the tale.

title: Brian Banks
description: The true story of Brian Banks, a high school football player who faces prison for a crime he didn't commit. Years later, with the support of the California Innocence Project, Banks fights to reclaim his life and fulfill his dreams of NFL stardom.

title: Hoot
description: After moving from Montana, a youth and his new friends in Florida take on corrupt politicians and greedy developers in a fight to protect endangered owls.

title: Isle of Dogs
description: In the future, an outbreak of canine flu leads the mayor of a Japanese city to banish all dogs to an island that's a garbage dump. The outcasts must soon embark on an epic journey when a 12-year-old boy arrives on the island to find his beloved pet.

title: It's Kind of a Funny Story
description: A depressed teenager (Keir Gilchrist) checks himself into a psychiatric facility and winds up in the adult ward, where a fellow patient (Zach Galifianakis) takes him under his wing.

title: The Switch
description: A woman (Jennifer Aniston) inseminates herself without knowing that her best friend (Jason Bateman) substituted her preferred sperm sample for his own.

title: Mid90s
description: In the 1990s Los Angeles, a 13-year-old spends his summer navigating between a troubled home life and a crew of new friends he meets at a skate shop.

title: The Predator
description: In Shane Black's explosive reinvention, the Predator is deadlier than ever, and only a ragtag crew can prevent the end of the human race.

title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
description: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race.

title: A Good Day to Die Hard
description: New York City cop John McClane (Bruce Willis) and his estranged son (Jai Courtney) must put aside their differences and work together to get a Russian whistleblower to safety and thwart a disastrous crime in Chernobyl.

title: A History of Violence
description: Vicious criminals continue to harass a man (Viggo Mortensen) and his wife (Maria Bello) after he thwarts a robbery attempt at his diner.

title: 3 Days to Kill
description: A dying Secret Service agent (Kevin Costner) who wants to reconnect with his estranged daughter (Hailee Steinfeld) is offered a potentially lifesaving drug in exchange for completing one final mission.

title: Inconceivable
description: Angela develops a friendship with a mysterious woman named Katie and offers her a job as a live-in nanny. The natural bond soon turns into a dangerous obsession as Katie becomes overly attached to the family's young daughter.

title: Girls Trip
description: Four best friends travel to New Orleans for the annual Essence Festival. Along the way, they rekindle their sisterhood and rediscover their wild side by doing enough dancing, drinking, brawling and romancing to make the Big Easy blush.

title: The Internship
description: Two old-school, unemployed salesmen internships at Google, then must compete with younger, smarter candidates for prime positions.

title: Ocean's 11
description: Veterans of the 82nd Airborne Division devise an elaborate plot to simultaneously rob five casinos on New Year's Eve.

title: Ocean's Eleven
description: Dapper Danny Ocean organizes a gang to steal $150 million from three Las Vegas casinos in a single heist.

title: Ocean's Twelve
description: To pay back casino boss Terry Benedict, Danny Ocean and his team of criminals plan an elaborate heist in Europe.

title: Ocean's Thirteen
description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor.

title: Repo Men
description: Set in the future when artificial organs can be bought on credit, a man struggles to make the payments on a heart he has purchased. He must go on the run before the heart is repossessed.

title: The Nun II
description: An evil spreads in 1956 France as a priest is murdered, and Sister Irene once again comes face-to-face with the demonic nun Valak.

title: Contagion
description: The world panics as doctors race to find a cure for a rapidly spreading virus that kills those contaminated within days.

title: Joker
description: Isolated, bullied and disregarded by society, failed comedian Arthur Fleck begins a slow descent into madness as he transforms into the criminal mastermind known as the Joker.

title: Joker: Folie à Deux
description: Struggling with his dual identity, failed comedian Arthur Fleck stumbles upon true love while incarcerated at Arkham State Hospital. Awaiting trial for the murder of five people, Fleck soon discovers the music that's always been inside him.

title: War for the Planet of the Apes
description: A ruthless colonel (Woody Harrelson) leads his troops in a deadly battle against Caesar (Andy Serkis) and his army of intelligent apes.

title: The Way, Way Back
description: After his mother's lover (Steve Carell) belittles him, a boy (Liam James) befriends a water-park employee (Sam Rockwell) who helps give him the confidence to come out of his shell.

title: My Big Fat Greek Wedding
description: Family tensions arise after a woman (Nia Vardalos) falls in love with a man (John Corbett) who is not Greek.

title: Smoking Tigers
description: Lonely 16-year-old Korean American Hayoung tries to hide her problematic family and lower-income background from her new wealthy friends.

title: Nanny McPhee Returns
description: Magical Nanny McPhee helps a harried mother who is trying to care for five children and tend to the family farm while her husband is away at war.

title: Shazam!
description: Billy Batson is a streetwise 14-year-old who can magically transform into the adult superhero Shazam simply by shouting out one word. His newfound powers soon get put to the test when he squares off against the evil Dr. Thaddeus Sivana.

title: Shazam! Fury of the Gods
description: When a vengeful trio of ancient gods arrives on Earth in search of the magic stolen from them long ago, Shazam and his allies get thrust into a battle for their superpowers, their lives and the fate of the world.

title: Robin Hood
description: In twelfth-century England, Robin Longstride and his band of marauders confront corruption in a local village and lead an uprising against the crown that will forever alter the balance of power.

title: Rampage
description: When three different animals become infected with a dangerous pathogen, a primatologist and a geneticist team up to stop them from destroying Chicago.

title: Tomb Raider
description: Hoping to solve the mystery of her father's disappearance, young Lara Croft embarks on a perilous journey to his last-known destination -- a fabled tomb on a mythical island that might be somewhere off the coast of Japan.

title: X-Men: First Class
description: Charles Xavier and Erik Lehnsherr work with other mutants to prevent a nuclear nightmare, but a situation soon tears the close friends apart.

title: The Alto Knights
description: The Alto Knights follow two of New York's most notorious crime bosses and how their separate paths to power place them on a deadly collision course.

title: Tomb Raider
description: Hoping to solve the mystery of her father's disappearance, young Lara Croft embarks on a perilous journey to his last-known destination -- a fabled tomb on a mythical island that might be somewhere off the coast of Japan.

title: Adult Best Friends
description: Katie takes her best friend on a nostalgic trip to their hometown to tell her she's getting married. Their journey soon takes some unexpected turns courtesy of a bizarre rental homeowner, a bachelor party, and a few potential love interests.

title: Epic
description: Magically transported to a secret realm, a teenage girl (Amanda Seyfried) joins an ongoing battle between the forces of good, which keep the natural world vital, and the forces of evil, which want to destroy it.

title: DC League of Super-Pets
description: Krypto the Super-Dog must convince a ragtag group of animals to master their own newfound powers to help him save Superman and the rest of the Justice League.

title: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
description: Still haunted by Beetlejuice, Lydia's life gets turned upside down when her daughter discovers a portal to the afterlife. When someone says Beetlejuice's name three times, the mischievous demon returns to unleash his very own brand of mayhem.

title: The Meg
description: A massive creature attacks a deep-sea submersible, leaving it disabled and trapping the crew at the bottom of the Pacific Ocean. With time running out, a rescue diver must now confront an unimaginable threat, a 75-foot-long prehistoric shark.

title: Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai
description: When his boss (John Tormey) turns against him, a hit man (Forest Whitaker) who lives like a samurai must fend for his life.
